def fast_pow(base, power, mod):
    result = 1
    while power > 0:
        if power & 1:
            result = (result * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        power >>= 1
    return result

MAXN = 300005
dp_table = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(27)]
factorial = [1] * MAXN
inv_factorial = [1] * MAXN

def permute(n, m, mod):
    return (factorial[n] * inv_factorial[n - m]) % mod

def main():
    n, K, MOD = map(int, input().split())
    if n % 2 == 1:
        print(fast_pow(K, n, MOD))
        return

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        factorial[i] = (factorial[i - 1] * i) % MOD

    inv_factorial[n] = fast_pow(factorial[n], MOD - 2, MOD)
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        inv_factorial[i] = (inv_factorial[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % MOD

    dp_table[0][0] = 1
    for k in range(K):
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            if (i & n) != i:
                continue
            block_mask = 1 << (31 - (i.bit_length() - 1))
            res = 0
            j = i
            cnt = 0
            while True:
                j_minus = (j - 1) & i
                j_plus = j_minus + block_mask
                res += dp_table[k][i ^ j_plus] * inv_factorial[j_plus]
                cnt += 1
                if cnt == 17:
                    res %= MOD
                    cnt = 0
                if j_minus == 0:
                    break
                j = j_minus
            res %= MOD
            dp_table[k + 1][i] = res

    total_ans = 0
    for i in range(K + 1):
        total_ans = (total_ans + factorial[n] * dp_table[i][n] * permute(K, i, MOD)) % MOD

    print((fast_pow(K, n, MOD) + MOD - total_ans) % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
